tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Krish Parekh's profile: summary, work experience with results, education and contact links, as markdown.

tools.name: get_hire_info
tools.description: Services Krish offers (voice agents, RAG assistants, multi-agent systems, AI pipelines), engagement options, FAQ and the booking link, as markdown.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: All projects with description, year, technologies and links to source code, live demos and technical articles.

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: All technical articles with slug, title, description, publish date, tags and reading time. Use get_post with a slug to read one.

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: The full text of one article as markdown. Get valid slugs from list_posts.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Any top-level page of krishparekhdev.com as markdown, including the reading list (books) and design and development resources (toolkit).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_posts, get_post · Private data: get_profile · Public sink: list_posts, get_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_posts, get_post · Private data: get_profile · Public sink: list_posts, get_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
